notes.title: Escape Space 1.0.0 is out!
notes.content:
Hello there, mercenaries.

I'm pleased to announce that Escape Space is fully completed and released in this new v1.0.0 build!

Thank you a lot for all of your continuous support and feedback during the Early Access phase, it helped me focus on what's important in bringing this game project to what it is today.

This update mostly adds quality-of-life features, improvements, and polish on top of the previous content build, see the changelog below.

Content creators, I've also published a [url=https://sites.google.com/view/escapespacepresskit]presskit[/url] where you can find any visual you'll need.

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]
[u]Demo build:[/u]
[list]
[*] The demo build has been updated to reflect the v1.0.0 of the game.
[*] The new maximum mercenary rank of the demo is 30.
[*] Achievements support has been removed from the demo build because it was too complex and time-consuming to manage two separate achievement trees.
[/list]
[u]New features:[/u]
[list]
[*] You can now preview all of the weapons on the loadout screen before purchasing any so that you'll see what their shooting pattern is before spending your credits.
[*] Added power-up notifications & timers on-screen when playing to better understand what you collect during a mission.
[/list]
[u]Improvements:[/u]
[list]
[*] Reworked the way the explosion VFXs work, for more boom all over the place.
[*] Reworked some visuals from the Upgrade tree to better understand what is unlocked and what isn't.
[*] The game will now exit smoothly when you click the Exit button.
[/list]
[u]Changes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Modified the way the Rampage mod works. Instead of slowing the time down, it now gives a flat % increase in fire rate for a few seconds.
[*] Changed the game's app icon.
[/list]
[u]Accessibility:[/u]
[list]
[*] Added an option to turn on/off the screenshakes.
[*] Added an option to turn on/off the flashes.
[*] Added an option to turn on/off the controller vibration.
[/list]
[u]Bug fixes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed missing/invalid translations (especially in French).
[*] Fixed Bill-E colors not properly updated in the Hub.
[*] Fixed a navigation issue that could happen when using the keyboard/controller with the frame to confirm a purchase.
[/list]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
With this update, the game will enter a freeze period. It means that no new features will be added for a few weeks to make sure that everything is working fine and to address hotfixes if necessary.

I may have some plans for the future of Escape Space, especially some end-game content for hardcore players, but I'll see how the game works first to better refine the ideas. 

So if any feedback please do not hesitate to reach out to me!

[h2]Thank you for reading![/h2]
Do you want to be featured in the next update announcement? Please send us your videos/articles at [b]shidygames[AT]gmail[DOT]com[/b]!

As always, thank you a lot for the support. As a solo developer, it means a lot.

Please continue reporting feedback and/or issues on [url=https://discord.gg/j8eVPQC2zD]Discord[/url]; it helps me better prioritize the next move for development!

And if you want to follow me on the journey of making this game, [url=https://twitch.tv/shidygames]I'm streaming the process every Tuesday/Thursday at 9 pm Paris time on Twitch[/url]!

Wanna discuss? I'm also on [url=https://twitter.com/shidygames]Twitter/X[/url]. Come say hi!

See you in space, mercenaries.
[url=http://shidygames.com]ShidyGames[/url].

notes.title: The final Early Access update: 0.10.0 (changelog)
notes.content:
Hello there, mercenaries.

It's almost time. After weeks without updates, we're pleased to announce that [b]the pre-launch Escape Space update, v0.10.0, is out[/b]!

It means that this will be the last content update before the full release of [b]Escape Space[/b]. Yes, we're almost there!

[h2]Important note for early access adopters[/h2]

[b]Your save files and Steam achievements will be wiped[/b], and we're very sorry about it. It's the first and last time this will occur, and there are good reasons why it happens now. Read the full patch notes to know more!

As always, thank you for your engagement in playing the game, and reporting feedback and issues. 

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]

[u]New features:[/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Brand new OST[/b]: we've worked with the amazing [b][url=https://www.linktr.ee/deltacrabmusic]Scott Hsu[/url][/b], who made all of the new OST for the game! Check out his [url=https://www.twitch.tv/deltacrabmusic]Twitch channel[/url], the OST will be soon available [url=https://scotthsumusic.bandcamp.com/album/escape-space-ost]here[/url].
[*] [b]Brand new story missions and scenarios [/b]: the game now has a total of 22 priority contract missions (but 12 are accessible during a single playthrough).
[*] [b]The maximum mercenary rank is now 99[/b], as initially planned!
[*] [b]Added the Hell difficulty scale[/b], for a total of 5 different difficulties.
[*] [b]Added 3 new game modes[/b]! You can now play Mayhem, Warfare, and Rush missions in addition to the 4 other game modes.
[*] [b]Added new enemies to every faction [/b].
[*] [b]Added 3 new weapons[/b]! Discover them playing the endgame content!
[*] [b]Added a new mod[/b]! Discover them playing the scenario missions!
[*] [b]New Steam Achievements[/b]: there are now 46 achievements to collect!
[*] [b]New player stats[/b]: check the career screen!
[*] [b]Added keyboard rebinding for shoot/use mod[/b]: it was one of the most asked features for accessibility reasons, and it's now a thing! And you can now shoot with the left click of the mouse!
[/list]

[u]Improvements:[/u]
[list]
[*] [b]Reworked UI[/b]! It's now in its final form.
[*] [b]Better/faster progression system[/b], it was way too long before that.
[*] [b]No reputation loss[/b] if you fail a priority contract mission, so you can now try hard without destroying your grind.
[*] [b]Bullet colors per faction[/b], so that it's even cooler.
[*] [b]New visual weapon designs[/b], because why not?
[*] [b]Reworked flash effect[/b] when entering/leaving a mission, so that it's less disturbing. It was a community request [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2131020/discussions/0/4036979087652610576/]listed here[/url].
[*] [b]Tons of improvements regarding the performance[/b]; the game should run even smoother than before!
[/list]

Do you want to be featured in the next update announcement? Send us your videos/articles at [b]shidygames[AT]gmail[DOT]com[/b]!

[h2]Thank you for reading![/h2]

As always, thank you a lot for the support. As a solo developer, it means a lot.

Please continue reporting feedback and/or issues on [url=https://discord.gg/j8eVPQC2zD]Discord[/url]; it helps me to prioritize better what the next move will be in terms of development!

And if you want to follow me on the journey of making this game, [url=https://twitch.tv/shidygames]I'm streaming the process every Tuesday/Thursday at 9 pm Paris time on Twitch[/url]!

Wanna discuss? I'm also on [url=https://twitter.com/shidygames]Twitter/X[/url]. Come say hi!

See you in space, mercenaries.

notes.title: New Update: 0.9.0 (changelog)
notes.content:
Hello there, mercenaries.

We gave Bill-E a brain. Yes, with the 0.9 of Escape Space, you will now be able to unlock and purchase new behaviors for Bill-E. 
Now, Bill-E is also part of the global customization scheme of the game and can be fine-tuned to match with your own playstyle!

Things might also be a little bit spicier. With the new Mercenary Rank cap set to 50, you will now be able to unlock the Nightmare contract missions! 
Beware, they are really hard and not meant to be easily done. So, take your best equipment, make sure you've purchased a ton of upgrades, and get to the fight!

Another balancing? Yes. Based on both personal testing and players' feedback, we made a lot of slight adjustments to all of the weapons available in the game.
But that's not all: we also made some more impactful design modifications that will impact both piercing and homing weapons.

See the full changelog below!

[h2]Patch notes[/h2]

[u]New features:[/u]
[list]
[*] Added the customization of behaviors for Bill-E. As soon as you unlock it in the Upgrades menu, you will be able to purchase and equip new behaviors for Bill-E.
[*] Moved the maximum Mercenary Rank from 40 to 50.
[*] Added Nightmare difficulty for contract missions.
[*] Added new enemies to every factions.
[*] Added two new priority missions.
[*] Added a new weapon: Shower (priority mission reward).
[/list]

[u]Improvements:[/u]
[list]
[*] Updated the object pooling feature. It will now preload a small amount of important items (bullets, special effects...) and add more into the pools if necessary during runtime. This will dramatically increase the loading time of the game without impacting the in-game performances.
[/list]

[u]Balancing:[/u]
[list]
[*] Changed the way piercing weapons are working. It will now be possible for a bullet to be stopped if the enemy it is colliding with is stronger than the damage output of the bullet. In addition, the bullet will lose some damage output potential every time it goes through an enemy.
[*] Changed the way homing weapons are working. Homing bullets will now only track targets that are in front of the player ship when fired.
[*] Vainquisher: slight damage output reduction.
[*] Firestorm: slight damage output increase.
[*] Glory: slight heat generation increase.
[*] Obliterator: slight heat generation reduction.
[*] Oblivion: slight damage output increase but rate of fire reduction.
[*] Seeker: slight heat generation reduction.
[*] Supremacy: slight heat generation increase and rate of fire increase.
[*] Tandem: slight damage output reduction and heat generation reduction.
[/list]

[u]Fixed issues:[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where, in some cases, enemies shooting in the direction of the player may not be able to aim at the player.
[*] Fixed missing translation: "mission.objective.intro".
[/list]

notes.title: New Update: 0.7.0 (changelog)

Hello there, mercenaries.

The past days have been crazy for me since the release of [b]Escape Space[/b] in Early Access. I would like to thank all of you who played the game and sent a lot of very insightful feedback, you are legends!

[*] Hellstorm: increased damage, reduced heat generation, reduced cone of fire.

notes.title: Early Access 0.6.0 is out!
notes.content:
After months of solo development, I'm pleased to announce that the [b]early access[/b] of Escape Space is now out on Steam!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758536/bc22133543d16163213e699293d5be5df1c83da0.png[/img]

[h1]About Escape Space[/h1]

[h2]The game[/h2]

You're a mercenary that pilots a spaceship for a living. To do so, you can accept contract missions from 3 different factions:
[list]
[*] The [b]Earth Military Conglomerate[/b]: the space military branch of the Earth's government. They usually have a lot of powerful assets and are considered as the powerhouse of the three factions.
[*] The [b]Void Outlaws[/b]: as their name suggests, they are a criminal organisation operating in space and minding their own business.
[*] The [b]Quantum Riders[/b]: a cult about technology, doing stange experimentations on their side. Considered as the most advanced faction of all three technologically speaking.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758536/697f7f5faa31afd66b751a5ac88b17fe76182ea7.png[/img]

[h2]The customization[/h2]

Thanks to the rewards you'll get by completing contract missions, you will be able to either earn or purchase new equipment for your spaceship:
[list]
[*] [b]Weapons[/b]: every weapon has its strenght and weakness, and a very different pattern from one to the other. Test them, and find out what weapons suit you the most!
[*] [b]Mods[/b]: you can equip your spaceship with a mod that will enable you to use or benefit from a special ability in addition to your weaponry! E.M.P., passive healing, energy shield... there are a lot of possibilites that will totally change your gameplay experience!
[*] [b]Colors[/b]: what about simply changing your colors? Well, of course you can!
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758536/283d099e3c454b9c3507d9f52a04d3187367f59d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758536/83316cfbb2c26ecaf211afa4cf9a7c58e123e1c1.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758536/d84a947625e1117f9d2035e957982801b579578f.png[/img]

[h2]The upgrades[/h2]

The game also features an upgrade tree where you can improve a lot of your items, and unlock some more specific features!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758536/44b25720bcfff1527b0ba46e6c6064920c0361e0.png[/img]

[h2]And that's it![/h2]

Enjoy handcrafted priority missions and procedurally generated contract missions!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758536/15b77810c9e0cde9a4116961db0e71a3a15f155c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758536/4c646d238501e8086091c4bd4cbf16a30eafba68.png[/img]

notes.title: Escape Space's demo update: 0.5
notes.content:
[h1]Escape Space demo build 0.5[/h1]

Where is the 0.4? Well, the 0.4 wasn't good enough to be announced, as it got a few annoying issues to deal with. So let's skip it and jump straight into the action with the brand new 0.5 update of Escape Space's demo!

[h2]Reworked Upgrades' grid.[/h2]

Root node is now unlocked by default, for free. For players that are having an old demo save and never unlocked it, it will now cost 0 chipsets to do so.

Moved Bill-E upgrade behind Firepower I, and reduced its price to 2500 chipsets. It is now longer a blocker to get to the weapon upgrades.

Moved Unlock Magnet before Unlock Power-Ups, and reduced its price to 250 chipsets. I understood the magnetism is very necessary for players, so it is now really easy to unlock it.

Added orange colored buttons. Now, red will mean locked (either for demo or because requirements aren't met yet), orange will mean too expensive but unlocked for purchase, blue will mean unlocked for purchase and possible to buy, and green will mean that you've already purchased it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758536/a9c282cb43bed9b6a293f792869441fd7f3e007f.png[/img]

[h2]Better gameplay flow.[/h2]

I've reconsidered the way the spawner of waves works and modified it slightly. From now, waves will spawn on a specified schedule and will never wait for you to get rid of the currently spawned enemies.

The more difficult the mission is, the faster the waves will spawn. So keep that in mind!

For that to work properly, waves' structure also got reworked. Now more being bullied by the enemies spawning in, unless you really want to and switch your difficulty settings!

Important note: starting at Medium difficulty, there is a possibility for elite waves to spawn. They act as breakpoints, so no more enemies will spawn until the wave has been beaten (otherwise it would become a real struggle to tackle them).

[h2]Bill-E 2.0![/h2]

Bill-E, the little autonomous drone companion, got buffed! It will now do x3 the damage it was before, being actually useful now.

[h2]Improved sound design.[/h2]

The way the audio effects are being played have been modified to better handle the moments when a lot of them have to fire.
[list]
[*] The audio system now pools from a list of available audio sources and use one when needed. This will be free again as soon as the audio has been played.
[*] If the audio sources pool isn't big enough, the game will make more audio sources and use them. This way, it will ensure all of the sounds can be played and properly size the pool depending on the need.
[/list]

All of the music and sound effects have been normalized to ensure they'll not damage players' ears. Audio channels have been reworked to reduce some types of sounds and to prioritize the important ones.

[h2]Better end-of-game summary.[/h2]

The end-of-game screen will now summarize all of the useful information faster and keep them displayed, so that the player can review them and exit a mission faster.

Same goes with the failed missions, but with a twist: we're now displaying a sentence that gives insights to the player about how the game works to help them, or a sentence submitted by our Twitch's community (redeemed with channel points)! The selection is made randomly within the pool!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758536/d793da7d73c19e1d54539ccf7152cc3e74cfa0ba.png[/img]

[h2]Fun stuff?[/h2]

The first big boss encounter for a scenario mission has been created from a live stream community redeem!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43758536/65e6c80bec074cd63de3fad78db04f2b230a9c7c.png[/img]

[h2]What else?[/h2]

[b]Much more![/b] A lot of small polishing everywhere, things that we fixed and so on. Try it, you'll feel the difference.

notes.title: Escape Space's demo update: 0.3

First...

The AI of the enemies got totally changed. Now, they truely have their own patterns and tactics. Most of the enemies changed, be ready for some new challenges!

Enemies, map, missions... a whole lot of new things appeared it the demo! Find them all!

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]

Performance should be way better in that version of the game, as we reworked a few component that were performance-heavy!

Consider [b]wishlisting the game![/b]

See you in space, mercernary!

notes.title: Escape Space's demo update: 0.2
notes.content:
[h1]Escape Space demo build 0.2[/h1]

Exciting news! A new version of the demo build is now available for free to play!

We've listened to all of your feedback and made sure to work on most of the relevant ones for this update, that features...

[h2]Two new game modes![/h2]

Embark for new mission types! This update adds different game modes to vary your gameplay experience and tactics!

[h3]Survival[/h3]

Survive for a set amount of time/waves. You did it? Well, you can keep fighting to earn even more rewards for all of the enemies you'll defeat, or leave the area. Warning: the more you stay, the harder it becomes!

[h3]Collect[/h3]

Go into a fight and collect the designated items from the scraps of your enemies!

[h2]Reworked story missions![/h2]

Reworked and new story missions have been developped for this update. The dialogs are more interesting, animated and the progression feels even better!

[h3]New UI[/h3]

All of the UI elements of the game have been reworked for clarity and readability.

[h3]Finally... Options![/h3]

The must-have is now a reality. With the Options menu, you can finally modify the game's volumes, and more!

[h3]Pause menu![/h3]

Another must-have, you can now pause the game whenever you want, so you won't be destroyed when having to take a phone call next time!

[h3]More customization possibilites![/h3]

We've added a few colors to the mix. We also added the ability to customize your thrusters' colors!
